experiment: E55 Stage C1: non-VPD instruments (pruning revival, reverse fine-tuning, steering) scored against the reuse ground truth from Stage A's two checks and Amendment 5.
plan: reports/plans/2026-10-29_plan_reuse-stage1.md, Stage C (C1) and Decision tree; user decision decisions.md 2026-10-30 (E55 truth set: option C done as Amendment 5, then option A with option B).
drafted: 2026-10-30 by the C1 code writer (not filed). The lead sets the truth set after the Amendment 5 check, then files (status 'filed ...'); c1.py refuses a draft.

constants_sources.truth_scored: Every LOW-based Stage A state whose count-a check reads 'through' (existing) or 'not through' (new) in a2_<arm>.json, at 1K and 10K; plus Amendment 5's WN seeds 0-3 and WNf at 1K, class 'reuses' in amend5.json (existing). c1.py's model-free control truth_matches_files re-derives each label from those files and stops on any mismatch. ID is excluded: it is the checks' positive control.
constants_sources.steering_only: R (HIGH, count-b check 'through' at both saves): the plan scores R for steering only, since pruning and reverse fine-tuning revive count a, which R never lost. Both saves listed; the per-seed score uses R's 1K state.
constants_sources.class_B: Option B (user, 2026-10-30): the third class, reported for every instrument without a pass bar. Drafted as every LOW-based Stage A state whose count-a check reads 'neither'. The decision card (reports/decisions/2026-10-29_decision_e55-stage-c-truth-set.md) names only the three all-spurious 10K states (W1, W1s1, W2 at 10K) as 'a rule of two counts'; M, M2 and W2 at 1K are 'neither' for other reasons. The lead may split the list.
constants_sources.scratch_lrs: The reverse lrs of the listed states (fine-tune lr / 10: 1e-4 -> 1e-5, 1e-5 -> 1e-6); model-free control every_reverse_lr_has_scratch.

definitions.pruning: Jain et al. 2024 Alg. 3 on MLP hidden units: unit j of block l scored by sum of grad . w over row j of the block's first MLP Linear and its bias, gradient of the count-a answer loss (cross-entropy at '=') on 1,000 fresh natural 'C a 40' rows (default_rng([1, 80])), fp32, eval mode. The top-K units are zeroed (weight row and bias: the unit's output is exactly 0). Count-a accuracy (fp32 argmax at '=') on Stage A's 4,000 'C a 40' rows (run.eval_seqs). Reference: 20 uniform K-unit draws over all 6 x 768 units (default_rng([301, K]), the same draws for every state).
definitions.reverse_fine_tuning: From the state, Stage A's fine-tune recipe (answer-only loss, AdamW betas 0.9/0.95, weight decay 0.1, batch 96, clip 1.0, 20% linear warm-up then cosine to lr/100 over the 10K cap, bf16 autocast) on natural 'C a 40' rows (Batches seed 300), lr = the state's fine-tune lr / 10. Count-a accuracy read every 50 steps on the first 1,000 of Stage A's 'C a 40' rows; steps = the first read >= 0.95; cap 10K. Scratch: NEVER's pretrained model, the same recipe, data and seed, at 1e-5 and 1e-6.
definitions.steering: E52 B3 (src/commute/steering.py) on this model: on Stage A's 1,000 qualifying 'C b 40' rows (run.a2_eval_data's b_texts), the target is the fine-tuned state's own argmax at '='. G = mean over rows of log P_tuned(target) - log P_base(target), on the fit half (even rows) and the scoring half (odd). Per block l in 1..5, v_l = fit-half mean of (tuned - base) residual at '=' after block l, added to the base there; share = mean steered change of log P(target) / G. S = the scoring-half share at the block with the largest fit-half share (ties to the lower block).
definitions.per_seed: One vote per training run: the run's 1K state when it is in the truth set (runs whose 1K state is class B drop out). Saves of one seed share a run and are not independent; the per-seed score has independent votes (seeds of one recipe still share it).

rules.prune_label: void if the unpruned count-a accuracy >= 0.95 (nothing to revive); 'existing' iff at K = 5 or K = 15, top-K accuracy - mean(random) >= 3 sd, sd = max(sd of the 20 draws (ddof 1), binomial sd of their mean at 4,000 rows, clipped to [1/n, 1-1/n]); else 'new'. Void for every state if the pruning control fails.
rules.prune_control: LOW, scores negated (the units whose removal raises count-a loss most): at K = 5 or 15, mean(random) - top-K accuracy >= 3 sd (same sd). Alg. 3's own direction on LOW is read and described only.
rules.reverse_label: void if scratch at the state's reverse lr took <= 1,000 steps, if the state starts at >= 0.95 (steps 0), or if a deadline cut the run; 'existing' iff steps <= 0.5 x scratch's steps (inclusive; a cap counts as 10,000 for either); else 'new'.
rules.steer_label: void if G_fit or G_score <= 0; 'existing' iff S >= 0.5 (inclusive); else 'new'.
rules.score: Per instrument, over the truth states it labelled 'existing' or 'new' (void drops the state; n shrinks): agree = labels equal to the truth. Pass bar a = the smallest a with P(Binomial(n, 0.5) >= a) <= 0.05, raised to majority + 1 when higher (majority = the larger truth class among the n). No bar when n < 8 (reported only). Passes iff agree >= a. Scored twice: 'all' (every truth state, the plan's bar) and 'per_seed' (1K states only). The plan's pass/fail reads 'all'; 'per_seed' is reported beside it and a pass on 'all' with a fail on 'per_seed' is reported as such.
rules.class_B_report: Per instrument, the count of each label among class B. No bar, no score.

pass_bars_at_draft_n.if_reverse_1e-5_void: scratch at 1e-5 <= 1K drops the 8 N states and WNf: n = 10 (7 existing, 3 new), bar 9; per seed n = 7 (no bar).
pass_bars_at_draft_n.if_reverse_1e-6_void: scratch at 1e-6 <= 1K drops M3, W1, W1s1 at 1K, the 4 WN seeds and M, M2, M3 at 10K: n = 9 (1 existing, 8 new), bar 9 (majority 8); per seed n = 5 (no bar).
pass_bars_at_draft_n.source: dry run (revival.pass_bar, revival.score); reproduces the plan's table n = 8, 12, 14, 16 -> 7, 10, 11, 12.

nuisance_labellers.what: Two model-free labellers that read only how a state was trained, scored on truth_scored by the same rule (c1.json scores.nuisance_short, scores.nuisance_slow): 'short' = fine-tuned <= 1K steps -> existing; 'slow' = fine-tune lr <= 1e-5 -> existing.
nuisance_labellers.at_draft_truth: short: 15 of 19 on 'all' (passes the bar of 14), 8 of 12 per seed (fails 10). slow: 15 of 19 on 'all' (passes), 11 of 12 per seed (passes 10). Dry run.
nuisance_labellers.why_it_matters: Every 'existing' state is a 1K-step state, and 7 of 8 were fine-tuned at 1e-5; 8 of 11 'new' states were fine-tuned at 1e-4. An instrument that reads only how far a state moved from LOW, or the lr, can pass both bars without telling reuse from new. Reverse fine-tuning's lr is tied to the fine-tune lr by the plan, which compounds this (its scratch comparison at the same lr is the only guard). See lead_notes 1.

C0_controls.claim: The instruments' controls hold: importance pruning on LOW lowers count a beyond the random draws, and scratch (NEVER) takes more than 1K steps at each lr.
C0_controls.threshold: rules.prune_control; scratch steps > 1,000 (a cap counts as 10,000).
C0_controls.expected: LOW unpruned ~0.9998 (a1_LOW.json 0.99975); random K = 5 and 15 draws ~0.999 (a few units of 4,608); importance top-15 well below. Scratch at 1e-5: 2K-6K steps (M, LOW at 1e-5, reached 33% count b at 1K, Table 6 32.6%); at 1e-6: the cap. Alg. 3's direction on LOW: ~0.9998 (ceiling), described.
C0_controls.on_miss: pruning control: pruning void for every state (n = 0, reported only); scratch at an lr: reverse fine-tuning void at that lr (pass_bars_at_draft_n gives the shrunk n). No stop: the other instruments run.
C0_controls.lean: pruning control 80% (5-15 units of 4,608 may not dent a 99.98% count); scratch > 1K at 1e-5 85%, at 1e-6 95%.

PC1_pruning.claim: Pruning revival agrees with the truth above chance.
PC1_pruning.threshold: agree >= 14 of 19 at the draft n (bar recomputed at the actual n).
PC1_pruning.expected: Most LOW-based states revive count a by a few units: Jain Fig. 76/77/79 show revival at every C_Tr after a 1e-4 fine-tune, so N states read 'existing' and disagree. Do-nothing reference: LOW itself would read void (count a at the ceiling).
PC1_pruning.blind_to: a revival that needs more than 15 units; units outside the MLP (attention); class B.

PC2_reverse_fine_tuning.claim: Reverse fine-tuning agrees with the truth above chance.
PC2_reverse_fine_tuning.threshold: agree >= 14 of 19 at the draft n.
PC2_reverse_fine_tuning.expected: N states (1e-4 fine-tunes, reverse at 1e-5) revive well inside half of scratch's steps (Jain Fig. 9: LOW's revival ~3K, near the scratch line; NEVER-based scratch is slower than Jain's), reading 'existing' and disagreeing; 1e-6 states revive slowly or hit the cap.
PC2_reverse_fine_tuning.blind_to: differences finer than the 50-step read; anything after the cap; class B.

PC3_steering.claim: Steering agrees with the truth above chance.
PC3_steering.threshold: agree >= 15 of 21 at the draft n.
PC3_steering.expected: Existing states (count a + 1 through a strengthened count of a) are close to a constant shift at '=': S >= 0.5. N states compute a new count: one mean vector recovers little of the gain, S < 0.5. R: G may be near 0 (HIGH already counts b at 99.7%), then void (E8). Do-nothing: tuned = base gives G = 0, void.
PC3_steering.blind_to: a reuse that needs an input-dependent shift; blocks' inputs other than the residual at '='; class B.

edge_cases.E1_void_instrument_baseline: Pruning control fails -> pruning void for every state: n = 0, no bar, 'reported only' (PC1 unscored, not a miss). Scratch at an lr <= 1K -> every state at that reverse lr voids (n shrinks, bars in pass_bars_at_draft_n). A void never counts as a vote.
edge_cases.E2_n_below_8: Fewer than 8 states left after voids -> no bar; the instrument is reported with its agreement and binomial p, not passed or failed (plan decision tree 3). The per-seed score drops below 8 under either scratch void.
edge_cases.E3_majority_reaches_a: The bar is raised to majority + 1 so a constant labeller fails. If that exceeds n the instrument cannot pass ('passes' false, bar > n), reported as unpassable. At the draft n the binomial bar is the higher in every case; under the 1e-6 scratch void (1 existing, 8 new) the bar is 9 of 9.
edge_cases.E4_ties: Inclusive as the plan words them: pruning diff >= 3 sd, reverse steps <= 0.5 x scratch, steering S >= 0.5, agree >= bar. Steering's best block ties go to the lower block. A state at exactly 0.95 counts as reaching the target.
edge_cases.E5_scratch_hits_cap: Scratch's steps count as 10,000 (plan). A state that also hits the cap counts as 10,000 > 5,000: 'new'. With scratch capped, 'existing' means reaching 95% within 5,000 steps.
edge_cases.E6_state_starts_at_target: Reverse steps 0 and pruning acc0 >= 0.95 are void (nothing to revive). Expected nowhere: every listed LOW-based state has count a <= 0.37 at 'C a 40' (a2_*.json count_a_te0, amend5.json); R (0.9998) is steering only.
edge_cases.E7_deadline: A reverse fine-tune cut by the deadline is discarded and rerun by the resubmitted job (never a reading; end 'deadline' would read void). Readings already in c1.json are kept; a changed RECIPE in c1.py drops them; a changed truth set keeps them and rescores.
edge_cases.E8_steering_gain_not_positive: G_fit or G_score <= 0 -> void. Likeliest for R, whose behaviour barely changes on natural rows.
edge_cases.E9_truth_disagrees_with_files: A listed label that the checks' files do not give stops the job before any model loads (model-free control truth_matches_files; c1_control_miss.json lists the mismatches).
edge_cases.E10_zero_denominator: score with n = 0: bar None, p = 1. Every reading has a fixed row count (1,000 / 4,000 rows), checked model-free.

departures_from_literature.jain: Reverse fine-tuning uses the hyperparameters of the Tracr fine-tune (SGD with momentum, 2K warm-up) at an lr below the fine-tune lr (App. D, L1249-1252); for PCFG, Fig. 76/77 reverse-fine-tune after a 1e-4 fine-tune.
departures_from_literature.ours: Stage A's PCFG fine-tune recipe (AdamW, batch 96, 20% warm-up then cosine over the 10K cap, so a 2K warm-up as in the Tracr recipe) at lr = the fine-tune lr / 10.
departures_from_literature.why: The Tracr SGD rates (1e-1 to 1e-4) have no AdamW equivalent on minGPT (plan).

departures_from_literature.jain: Scr.+FT: a model pretrained to count the fine-tuning operand, then fine-tuned (L457-460); its prior is not given.
departures_from_literature.ours: NEVER (operand prior 0, 1, 0), fine-tuned on count a with the same recipe, data and lr as the state.
departures_from_literature.why: NEVER is the only base that never counted a (plan). It never saw the 'C a' prefix, so it is slower than Jain's baseline: a bias toward 'existing', reported beside the score.

departures_from_literature.ours: E52's B3 baseline (mean residual shift, gain share, layer chosen on a fit half, scored on the other) at '=' after blocks 1-5.

departures_from_literature.jain: Not in Jain et al.; E52 B3 scores log P of the task's label at each block's input.
departures_from_literature.ours: log P of the fine-tuned state's own argmax; block outputs 1-5 (the last block's output is excluded, as interchange.l_star excludes it; E52's embedding-output site is not used).
departures_from_literature.why: On qualifying rows a reusing state answers count(a) + 1, never the label count(b), so the label's gain would be negative exactly where reuse is the truth. The last block's output is excluded because a shift there acts on the head directly.

departures_from_literature.jain: Neuron pruning for PCFG, 'a neuron is defined as a row in the weight matrix', over unstated matrices (App. D).
departures_from_literature.ours: MLP hidden units only: rows of each block's first MLP Linear with their bias (4,608 units).
departures_from_literature.why: Plan ('MLP hidden units'); a zeroed row and bias remove the unit exactly.

departures_from_literature.jain: Accuracy curves against the number of pruned neurons (Fig. 7, 79); no random-unit baseline, no threshold.
departures_from_literature.ours: K in {5, 15} (Fig. 7's 5-15), 20 random K-unit draws, 'existing' iff the top-K gain beats them by 3 sd.
departures_from_literature.why: A label needs a rule and a null (plan).

departures_from_literature.ours: On LOW, the same scores negated (importance pruning) must lower count a beyond the random draws.
departures_from_literature.why: Alg. 3's own direction lowers count-a loss, so on LOW (99.98% count a) it cannot move accuracy; the negated score is the only direction in which LOW shows the score finds units count a uses.

departures_from_literature.what: Reverse fine-tuning read as a label
departures_from_literature.jain: Accuracy curves against reverse fine-tuning steps beside the scratch curve (Fig. 9, 76/77).
departures_from_literature.ours: Steps to 95% count a, read every 50 steps on 1,000 rows, cap 10K; 'existing' iff <= half of scratch's.

departures_from_literature.jain: Fine-tunes are analysed at the end of training.
departures_from_literature.ours: Most 'existing' states are 1K saves, inside the 10K schedule's warm-up (Stage A, Amendment 5).
departures_from_literature.why: Stage A found the checks' reading changes between 1K and 10K.

departures_from_literature.what: Per-seed bar and nuisance labellers (added here)
departures_from_literature.ours: A second score with one vote per training run (its 1K state); two model-free labellers (short fine-tune, low lr) scored beside every instrument.
departures_from_literature.why: Saves of one seed are not independent; the truth set is confounded with fine-tune length and lr (nuisance_labellers).

blind_to: Instruments are scored only on states the two checks label; class B is described. The truth set's 'existing' side is 8 states from two recipes (Stage A's spurious 1e-5 fine-tunes at 1K, Amendment 5's natural-text WN), all at 1K. VPD (C2).
positive_control: Pruning: importance pruning on LOW (C0). Reverse fine-tuning: none of its own beyond scratch > 1K; ID (Amendment 5's positive control for 'reuses') is not read here (it is not a count-b fine-tune and is excluded from the truth). Steering: none; do-nothing (tuned = base) gives G = 0, void.
not_run_here: C2 (VPD); Stage B; ID states; Amendment 5's 500 and 2K saves; swap-built rows; any lr other than the plan's lr / 10.
dry_run: 2026-10-30, ~/commute-data/scratch/reuse-lead/e55-c1/dry_run.py (model-free, cpu-run, 5-12 s): all 10 model-free controls pass (truth set matches a2_*.json and amend5.json; 27 state files exist; R HIGH-based, the rest LOW-based; reverse lrs 1e-5 and 1e-6 both have scratch; score, eval, reverse-training and steering rows well formed; the plan's bar table reproduced). 27 states: 19 scored (8 existing, 11 new), 2 steering only (R), 6 class B. Reverse lr 1e-5: the 8 N states, WNf and W2 (class B); 1e-6: the rest. Bars and nuisance scores as in pass_bars_at_draft_n and nuisance_labellers.
job_split: Stage A and Amendment 5 ran at ~12.5 ms/step (a2.log, amend5.log). Upper bounds with every reverse fine-tune at the 10K cap: <= 2.9 min per reverse fine-tune (125 s of steps, 200 reads of 1,000 rows, compile), <= 3.3 min per state with pruning and steering, ~10 s per steering-only state. Job 1 (c1 controls, --time 00:15:00): LOW pruning twice and scratch at 2 lrs, <= 7 min. Then c1 states: 25 x 3.3 + 2 x 0.2 <= 83 min, 6 states per 22-min job: up to 4 debug jobs by deadline, exit 3 and resubmit (the sbatch allows c1 6 resubmits). States that reach 95% early finish sooner.
lead_notes: 1. The truth set is confounded with how the states were trained: every 'existing' state is a 1K save and 7 of 8 were fine-tuned at 1e-5, while 8 of 11 'new' states are 1e-4 fine-tunes. The model-free labeller 'lr <= 1e-5 -> existing' scores 15 of 19 (passes 14) and 11 of 12 per seed (passes 10). A pass by an instrument should be read beside the nuisance scores; adding 'new' states at 1e-5 and 1K (none is labelled now: M and M2 at 1K are 'neither') or 'existing' states at 1e-4 (WNf only) would break the confound.

2. Reverse fine-tuning's lr is the fine-tune lr / 10 (plan), so the states split into a 1e-5 group (the 8 N states and WNf) and a 1e-6 group (everything else); each is compared with scratch at its own lr. If scratch at 1e-5 takes <= 1K, PC2 is left with 10 states, 7 of them existing.

3. The brief's pruning control ('pruning on LOW must lower count a') is implemented with the score negated: Alg. 3's direction lowers count-a loss and cannot lower LOW's accuracy. Alg. 3's direction on LOW is read and described.
4. R is listed at both saves; the plan says 'R' without a save. R's steering gain may be near zero (HIGH already counts b): E8 voids it rather than guessing.
5. Class B is drafted as all six 'neither' states; option B's card names three. The rule does not change either way (no bar).
